tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Easy Editor profile (display name, email, country, preferred language, approval status).

tools.name: list_recent_sessions
tools.title: List recent Easy Editor sessions
tools.description: List the signed-in user's most recent Easy Editor sessions (Transcribe, OCR, Speak, Editor, etc.), newest first. Optionally filter by section.

tools.name: list_research_sessions
tools.title: List Islamic Research sessions
tools.description: List the signed-in user's Islamic Research chat sessions, newest first, with title, mode and selected source domains.

tools.name: token_balance
tools.title: Get token balance
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Easy Editor token wallet: monthly balance, monthly limit, and top-up balance.

tools.name: search_islamic_corpus
tools.title: Search Islamic Corpus
tools.description: Keyword search over Easy Editor's local corpus: the Quran with translations, the canonical hadith collections, fatwa and ingested classical books. Lexical (whole-word substring) matching only — not semantic, and it does not include the live Turath.io library. Rows are ranked by how many of the query's words they contain.

query.description: Search query in Arabic or Urdu

domain.description: Restrict to one kind of source (default: all)

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return

tools.name: takhrij_hadith
tools.title: Takhrij Hadith Cross-Reference
tools.description: Find other narrations of a hadith across the canonical collections in Easy Editor's corpus, by matching the matn's content words. The best keyword match is treated as the primary narration and the rest are compared against it. Matching is on wording only — a same hadith_number in another collection is never a match, because numbering is per-collection.

hadithText.description: Hadith matn or phrase in Arabic to find cross-references for

minOverlapRatio.description: Minimum content-word overlap (default 0.5, the same threshold the app uses)

tools.name: calculate_faraid
tools.title: Calculate Islamic Inheritance (Fara'id)
tools.description: Pure deterministic Islamic inheritance calculation adhering to the Jumhūr consensus. Calculates Asl al-Mas'alah, fixed shares, residuary (asaba), Awl, and Radd with Quranic and Hadith proofs.

heirs.description: Map of surviving heir type to count, e.g. { husband: 1, daughter: 2, mother: 1, fullBrother: 1 }

estateValue.description: Optional total cash or property value to distribute

currency.description: Currency symbol/code for estate valuation (default PKR)
